note: Century-old family resort on Crooked Lake (7.5 hp limit) in the Northern Kettle Moraine, with a beach and slide, boat and canoe rentals, bar and concession stand. Mostly seasonal: about 55 of its 180 sites are sold by the night, most of them apart from the seasonal areas. Camp rules allow one family per site. --Claude
summary: Operator: $50 W/E, $36 tent, 55 campsites + 125 seasonals (~31% nightly), May 1-Oct 15, phone booking, 2-night minimum (3 holidays). Google 4.4 (283). Price gate: $50 passes (not over). Lakefront kept on peninsula sites 1-10. Note gains the mostly-seasonal line.
flags: LONG-STAY: 55 campsites + 125 seasonal = 180; about 31% sold by the night (tent sites counted). Posted nightly rates, site count, Google 4.4 (283 reviews); no wording discouraging nightly guests ('Come spend a weekend, a week or the summer'). Passes at 10-50%; the note says 'Mostly seasonal' as the rule asks. No Good Sam (stored false).
PRICE GATE (private): $50 a night before tax for electric/water sites - at the limit, not over; passes. Rates undated (site footer 2025). gateways.py: none within 40 km (nearest Milwaukee 68 km).
MINIMUM STAY: a standing 2-night minimum all season (under the 3-night drop line); 3 nights on holiday weekends.

WATERFRONT lakefront kept: the numbered peninsula campsites on the lake side of the peninsula loop (map sites 1-10, about 43.6253,-88.1546 to 43.6260,-88.1549) sit between the loop road and Crooked Lake, about 10-30 m from the water over open mown grass with scattered trees and fire rings on Esri leaf-off imagery; they are the nightly campsites (the trailers inside the loop are seasonals). The map's sites 11-19 face the reedy north shore/marsh and are not counted.
Pin 43.6245,-88.1538 is at the main building by the beach, ~100-200 m south of the peninsula sites; kept (under 250 m).
PHONE 262-626-2221 confirmed (operator site and Google). WEBSITE kept.
Fit: no rig-length limit stated; the peninsula sites are open grass.
